scientific_integrity: The analytic argument supplies universal quantifiers; exact polynomial checks and rational examples supplement it. No independent validation or complete literature priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Scalar complex Dahlquist test equation and independent identically distributed stage fractions only.
The two-point design generally sacrifices mean-stage matching to order two and is not claimed to preserve nonlinear convergence order.
No multidimensional B-stability, general nonlinear convergence, dependent-stage or arbitrary Runge–Kutta tableau conclusion.
Residual risk of an earlier unindexed derivation in stochastic theta or random-coefficient stability literature.
title: Sharp mean-stage obstruction and two-point A-stability frontier for randomized implicit RK2
